content.title: Where To Watch The 2026 Oscar Nominees: 'Sinners' To 'Frankenstein'
content.text: Skip to main content Where To Watch The 2026 Oscar Contenders, From ‘Sinners’ To ‘Sentimental Value’ L-R: Michael B. Jordan in 'Sinners', Renate Reinsve in 'Sentimental Value' and Benicio del Toro in 'One Battle After Another' Warner Bros, Neon, Warner Bros Warner Brothers and A24 provided some of the top Oscar contending-films of 2026 from One Battle After Another to Sinners and Marty Supreme. Netflix also scored many nominations with Frankenstein and Train Dreams. Thanks to industry deals, several Oscar-nominated films are streaming, or will be streaming, ahead of the ceremony. Whether you want to watch Jessie Buckley’s emotional performance in Chloe Zhao’s Hamnet or hear Ludwig Goransson’s score for Ryan Coogler’s Sinners, below lies a list of where to watch the various Oscar contenders before the big day on March 15 when the winners will be revealed. RELATED: Oscar Nominations 2026: ‘Sinners’ Leads With Record 16, ‘One Battle’ Next – The Complete List The below list includes 25 films nominated in the major categories like Best Actress, Best Animated Feature and Best Original Song. They are listed according to number of nominations they’ve received, highest to lowest. ‘Sinners’ – HBO Max‘One Battle After Another’ – HBO MaxPhoto : Warner Bros. / Courtesy Everett Collection‘Sentimental Value’ – For Rent on Prime Video, Apple TV and Fandango At HomePhoto : Kasper Tuxen/Neon/Everett Collection‘Frankenstein’ – NetflixPhoto : Ken Woroner/Netflix‘Marty Supreme’ – HBO Max Timothée Chalamet’s ping pong starrer from A24 will likely go to HBO Max for streaming because the streamer has a deal with A24. For now, it is available for rent on Prime Video, Apple TV, Fandango At Home and Plex. ‘Hamnet’ – Going To Peacock‘Bugonia’ – PeacockPhoto : Focus Features/Everett Collection‘Train Dreams’ – Netflix‘F1’ – Apple TVPhoto : Warner Bros. /Courtesy Everett Collection‘The Secret Agent’ – HuluPhoto : Neon/Everett Collection‘Avatar: Fire And Ash’ – Coming to Disney+Photo : 20th Century Studios James Cameron’s third entry in the Avatar film series will soon head to Disney+ ahead of the March 15 Oscars ceremony. ‘Blue Moon’ – Streaming On Netflix, For Rent on Prime Video, Apple TV and FandangoPhoto : Sony Pictures Classics‘It Was Just An Accident’ – For Rent on Apple TV, Plex, Prime Video and Fandango At HomePhoto : Neon/Everett Collection‘KPop Demon Hunters’ – Netflix‘Sirat’ – TBD Sirāt is not currently streaming anywhere. ‘Weapons’ – HBO MaxSong Sung Blue – For Rent on Prime Video & Apple TV, Coming to Peacock (Focus Features)Photo : Courtesy of Focus Features‘If I Had Legs I’d Kick You’ – HBO MaxPhoto : Sundance Institute‘Zootopia 2’ – Coming to Disney+Photo : Walt Disney Animation‘Elio’ – Disney+‘Arco’ – For Rent On Prime Video And Fandango At Home Best Animated Feature entry Arco is not currently streaming anywhere, but it is available to rent on Prime Video, Fandango At Home and Plex. ‘Little Amélie or the Character of Rain’ – For Rent on Prime Video, Apple TV, Fandango At Home and PlexPhoto : Ikki Films, Maybe Movies ‘Diane Warren: Relentless’ – Streaming on Kanopy & Hoopla, For Rent on Prime Video, Apple TV, Fandango At Home and Plex‘Viva Verdi!’ – For Rent On Jolt Viva Verdi! is not available for streaming, but it can be rented via Jolt. ‘The Smashing Machine’ – HBO MaxPhoto : Eric Zachanowich / © A24 / Courtesy Everett Collection No nominations for Dwayne Johnson or Emily Blunt in The Smashing Machine, but the film did receive a makeup and hairstyling nomination. Like Marty Supreme and If I Had Legs I’d Kick You, the A24 film is part of the HBO Max and A24 streaming deal.
